items.title: Artie Shaw — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Dardenelle, what he did with that.

ctx.x: Can you remember the first occasion you heard Coleman Hawkins?

I think it was Fletcher [Henderson] at the Roseland Ballroom. I remember him. I remember Tricky Sam [Nanton]. I can’t remember a lot about that band. I didn’t . . . The band didn’t impress me much. But when the Hawk played, or Bean, as they called him, that was a whole new thing. He had great chord sense . . . Now, today, that’s nothing, but in that day . . . One Hour, Jesus, what he did with that If I could be with you one hour tonight. It was remarkable. Bix was always around. When he was with [Paul] Whiteman,…
Did you hear Bix with the Whiteman band? Did you hear them actually?
